purpose: E8-04 cross-platform reference-consistency ledger: the Gate B frame bridge, run through the unified pinned-EOP mechanism (tests/data/flightlab/reference/earth_orientation.json, pinned-bundled mode, no download), must re-derive the committed GCRS tracks from the raw recorded OpenTsiolkovsky outputs within one declared band on every supported CI platform.
notes: The CI matrix (test job linux-64 + test-macos osx-64/osx-arm64, all from envs/cpu.conda-lock.yml) runs tests/test_e804_cross_platform.py on all three platforms with the identical locked astropy 6.1.7 / astropy-iers-data 0.2026.8.31.0.57.9 stack; the test computes the observation live and asserts it inside the band.
linux-x86_64 was recorded locally on the recording stack (see observed_utc); the observation is bit-deterministic across runs.
null means no ledger observation has been recorded yet for that platform; a null entry makes the test verify the band live on that platform instead of comparing to a stored value.
